units.title: Identity sessions MFA passkeys
units.acceptanceCriteria: Complete identity sessions mfa passkeys functionality, contract and authorization-negative tests, documentation, and recorded acceptance evidence.
verification: One-time expiring passkey challenges are bound to HTTPS origin and relying-party ID; successful assertions require verified user presence, exact binding, and monotonic authenticator counters.
Identity tests deny unknown, expired, mismatched, replayed and revoked input uniformly before session issuance and verify bounded MFA session expiry and revocation.

units.acceptanceCriteria: Complete tenancy boundary audit logs functionality, contract and authorization-negative tests, documentation, and recorded acceptance evidence.
verification: Every organization authorization decision appends a structured immutable event with opaque ID, integer timestamp, action, tenant context, resource tenant and outcome.
